meaning:
1) to bend, kneel, bow, bow down, sink down to one's knees, kneel down to rest (of animals), kneel in reverence
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to bow
1a2) to bow down, crouch
1a3) to bow down over
1a4) to tilt, lean
1b) (Hiphil) to cause to bow

renderings.kjv: likewise every one that boweth down

renderings.bsb: You have brought me to my knees

renderings.kjv: and ye shall all bow down
